name: agentloop
description: AgentLoop harness - multi-mode agent loop engine with Supervisor, Complex, Gui, Custom, Simple modes and app-based customization.

maxConcurrentTasks.description: Maximum number of concurrent tasks per user session.

maxConcurrentTools.description: Maximum number of tools executed in parallel within a single loop turn.

defaultLoopType.description: Default loop mode used when no binding or schedule route exists.

enabled.description: Enable steer mode for mid-execution user intervention.

maxTurns.description: Maximum number of loop iterations per turn.

waitTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for loop-level compaction.

writeToDisk.description: Write agentloop-manifest.json to the workspace so embedded runner can discover available agents.

maxConcurrentTasks.label: Max Concurrent Tasks
maxConcurrentTasks.help: Maximum number of concurrent tasks per user session.

maxConcurrentTools.label: Max Concurrent Tools
maxConcurrentTools.help: Maximum number of tools executed in parallel within a single loop turn.

defaultLoopType.label: Default Loop Mode
defaultLoopType.help: Loop mode used when no session binding or schedule route exists. Supervisor uses classifier routing, ReAct follows think-act-observe cycles.

steer.enabled.label: Enable Steer
steer.enabled.help: Allow users to inject additional messages during loop execution.

loop.maxTurns.label: Max Turns
loop.maxTurns.help: Maximum number of loop iterations per turn.

compact.waitTimeoutMs.label: Compaction Wait Timeout
compact.waitTimeoutMs.help: Maximum time to wait for loop-level compaction to complete.

manifest.label: Manifest
manifest.help: Controls for agent manifest file generation.

manifest.writeToDisk.label: Write Manifest
manifest.writeToDisk.help: Write agentloop-manifest.json so embedded runner can discover available agents without loading the plugin.
